headline: CHC @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.51 at SFG 3.89, with a projected total of 8.40. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved -0.27 runs while SFG moved -1.35, changing the projected margin by +1.08 runs. The projected total fell -1.61, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ryan Rolison has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Jung Hoo Lee, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
